en.headline: Observatory issues Yellow Fire Danger Warning as risk stays high
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow signal at 6am on Monday, urging the public to take precautions against fires and hikers to remain vigilant.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6:01am on Monday, stating that the fire risk is high.
The Observatory said the fire danger situation today is yellow and urged people to prevent fires from breaking out. Hikers were also advised to be vigilant.
The warning remains in force until further notice. The public is reminded to be extra alert and ensure necessary fire precautions are taken, particularly in dry conditions.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 火災風險偏高
zh.dek: 天文台周一早上六時發出黃色火災危險警告，指火災危險性頗高，呼籲市民採取防火措施，行山人士亦需提高警覺。
body: 香港天文台於周一早上六時零一分發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災風險偏高。
天文台指，今日火災危險情況屬黃色，市民應防止火災發生，行山人士亦要特別提高警覺。
警告現時仍然生效，直至另行通知。市民應特別提高警覺，並確保採取適當防火措施，尤其在乾燥天氣下。
